name: io.github.johnnywuj81/tokenknows
title: TokenKnows
description: Distill AI coding sessions into weekly reports, ADRs and a knowledge graph - self-hosted

environmentVariables.name: TOKENKNOWS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token (tkk_...) or JWT bearer for the backend; create one in the web UI under Project Settings - MCP Access (optional for default local deployments)

environmentVariables.name: TOKENKNOWS_DEFAULT_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project_id for event submission and distill

environmentVariables.name: TOKENKNOWS_WEB_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Web UI base URL used to build view_url links returned by distill/list tools (login required to open them)
